<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 9"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Malleable](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2614)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Metal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=505" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 146

**Price** 650 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** etched onto a metal medium or heavy armor

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The metal of your armor can shift and rearrange at a moment's notice, allowing you to manipulate what kind of damage it resists.

**Activate—Reconfigure Armor
** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** The armor's composition shifts, changing its [specialization](/Rules.aspx?ID=211) group to a different one of your choice. This doesn't change what the armor is made of, and any runes or precious material it's made of apply to the new composition. Any property runes that can't apply to the new form are suppressed until the item takes a composition to which they can apply.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
name: Malleable
